description: Edit a source tag. Custom tag: rename, add patterns, remove exact patterns from the listing. Built-in tag (platform): add patterns to this website's copy so they carry the tag here, or remove patterns so they stop carrying it here; a removal is accepted only for a pattern the tag currently applies to (by a platform rule, by automatic classification, or by your own addition), and an addition is accepted only when the pattern does not already carry the tag. Owned and Competitor cannot be edited here; their patterns live in Brand Profile and Competitors. Read the listing first and pass the tag's revision as expected-revision. Obtain explicit user confirmation of the exact changes before calling; MCP executes immediately after authorization; Athena AI chat presents an approval card. If the tag changed, read again. Never retry a declined proposal unless asked. Up to 500 additions and 500 removals. A false analytics-refresh result means the edit saved but filtered analytics may still be cached.

items.description: Host (example.com), subtree (*.example.com), path section (example.com/blog), exact page (example.com/blog$) or query constraint (youtube.com/watch?v=abc).

name.description: Custom tag name. Names of built-in tags (Media, Social, Government, …) and of Owned and Competitor are reserved.
